reviews.comment: Dessler was a great professor, he was funny and passionate. Unfortunately, he gives 5 quizzes, around 14 questions, and they are extremely hard. The final is worth 30% of your grade, and it is equally as difficult. If you are looking for a no-work class, this is not it. Everything outside of the quizzes/tests are easy.

This guy obviosuly really cares about climate change and the environment. Made a GroupMe to contact us about real time events which was cool. He sent a lot of pics and videos of his dogs. The content itself wasn't too hard and the group project at the end of the class was pretty fun but stressful. I reccomend this class for anyone who needs a fill.

Great professor and great class! One group project, 5 quizzes, 1 exam. Professor Dessler is full of passion about climate change and what it takes to make a difference. He is also flexible and willing to work with you if you communicate with him. Say Hi to Tagger and Bullet!

This class was THE best class I've taken at A&M. Andrew Dessler is very passionate about the topic and is beyond qualified (the man has worked everywhere). If you have the opportunity to take this class, please do because not only is applicable to almost ALL of the classes I have taken but it's also super important for life. He taught me so much!

We had a few extra credit assignments but the main ones were from participation. It would always be the same people participating so most didn't get to get the extra credit on that. Attendance is mandatory since we did pollEv about the reading and notes. The exams are a bit challenging if you don't study well, and the math was easy to grasp on

My favorite class of college so far! Was nervous it would be hard, but all the ppl saying this class is "so hard & full of math" are being drama fr. He explains everything really well and is super engaging. Class participation will get you extra credit as well! 5ish quizzes, 4 HW assignments, cumulative final. Take this class, you wont regret it!

Great professor who really cares about the subject. Easy homeworks (only 3) and one easy group project. 5 quizzes that were hard for me but he drops the lowest one. Only exam is the final which is worth 30% of grade but it was easy if you study. Only thing is GO TO CLASS!! He does Pollev in class and I barely went so got a B overall.

He was my favorite professor this semester. Explains concepts very well, so they are easy to understand. The only test is the final exam, and he mentions what you should know for it throughout the course. You can tell he cares about students. Also responded to emails quickly.

You can tell Professor Dessler really cares about the subject matter he is teaching. A pretty easy class for a science credit, but make sure you keep up to date with the textbook readings and video notes. Get ready to be overwhelmed with videos of his two dogs.
Only a few tests + here-and-there assignments. An A is not hard, but only way to get an A on the test in to get a 100 so.

if you need a science class... TAKE THIS ONE!! prof dessler is really great at teaching and is very passionate. i never read for classes, but i read the whole text book (he wrote it). it is very helpful to read, but the videos are very detailed, so it's not really necessary. there are 5 quizzes, one is dropped, and one final. all online. an easy A!

Dr. Dessler is a great professor and the class was not difficult. However, I would say that you need to take good notes and put in the effort. It isn't hard to get 100s on the homework, and discussion posts. There are a couple of group projects, 5 quizzes (he drops the lowest quiz), and a final exam. 
Easy class overall!

There are lecture videos that you need to watch each week but most are less than 10 minutes long. Quizzes are easy if you review the powerpoints. Textbook is not required but he highly suggests you read it. I wouldn't say it's necessary.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Still one of the best professors I have ever had. Not a particularly intrinsic subject, but as an online class it is easy enough. Definitely study for the final. Other than that, Dessler is very passionate and very knowledgeable. He also includes videos of animals at the end of his lectures as a treat. Great dude.

Dessler is respected in the climate change community. I thought taking this class would help me be more prepared and better equipped for combating climate change but it eventually got to the point to where I was fighting for my grade instead of climate change. 5 quizzes (1 is dropped) + final exam is worth 70% of your grade -- be aware.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment:
Honestly best prof Ive ever had. 
The modules with math are difficult in the beginning, but after doing the homeworks, which you can do as many times as youd like, its easier to understand. 
less than 10 assignments the entire semester and most were pretty easy. 
as long as you understand his lecture videos you will do great in his class.

Professor Dessler was one of the best professors I've had in my college career. This class was entirely online, but was my favorite class this year. His lectures are engaging and easy to understand. If you put in the effort into this class, it is not difficult. Professor Dessler wants you to succeed; he is always helpful and offers extra credit.

His lectures are good. However, this class has a lot of MATH, and I didn't find his lectures helpful when trying to understand the equations. His tests are ridiculously hard. He takes off multiple points for every HOUR something is late. He's not lenient about late work either, no matter what the circumstances are. Cool dude, but has no sympathy...

I absolutely love this class. Prof. Dessler knew how to teach cohesively and it's really obvious how much he cares about what he's teaching. This is a pretty straightforward and easy enough class about really important topics.

The lecture videos are easy to follow along with as long as you take notes, and he includes his dogs at the end of every video. Stay up to date with lectures if you want to make sure you're on top of everything. The exams weren't difficult if you took the time to study, there are quizlets and review videos that help significantly with studying.

He is an amazing professor. If you think this is an easy A, it's not. You got to work for it. I messed up by not doing well on the test but if you study you are good. Also there is MATH in this course but its easy if you get the hang of it. Remember the smallest details.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Dessler's class! You do have to read the textbook because some of the test questions come straight from there. Also, pay attention to the lecture videos, basically, all the info you need for assignments and test come from either lectures or the textbook. The class is also MATH-based. It's easy math but be aware of that.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is a great professor and really listens to his students. The class does have a lot of math in so if you arent good at math maybe choose a different science. He is a wonderful teacher and cares for his students. He is will to work with students on any issues or concerns. I would take this professor again. MATH HEAVY class
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Everyone complaining about the math in these reviews are just bad at math. He gives you the formulas to use, the most advanced math are just logs and exponents, WHICH HE EXPLAINS!! He's an amazing professor, but the course is textbook and video heavy, so you'll have to put in some effort for an A, but it's doable (I an A for the entire sem).

Took GEOS210 online. Lockdown Browser for all quizzes and exams. You have to read the textbook (only about 200+ pages total tho) to do well in this class as he does ask questions where the answer is only found in the textbook. Class is cumulative so stay on top of it. Dessler is a great professor and an easy grader. 7/10 difficulty

Professor Dessler is an amazing person.... but his class is extremely difficult. This course is heavily math based so if you aren't good at math good luck. However, he tries to make his lectures fun and short. He provides great feedback and will help you if you reach out and show that you care. I recommend him but don't think it will be an easy A
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is honestly a great class, and by no means it is not an easy class. You must work for your grade, as in any other class. This class was entirely online. This is not a class that you can just intake information last minute and expect to pass, and you must stay on top of your readings and videos.

TA taught my class, lectures are really informative. Quizzes are hard even looking in the book for answers. Tests were 10-15 questions short answer over 3-4 chapters they were difficult, study guides dont help that much. Math is incorporated in the class and hard to do. Interesting topics you learn but class material is hard to grasp at times.

Dr. Dessler himself is kind and passionate. He is also a good professor. That being said, this class is EXTREMELY difficult and heavily math based. The concepts can be very hard to grasp. If you are looking for a fun and average difficulty class, THIS IS NOT IT. Get ready for hours of assignments, studying, and stress.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is one of the WORST classes I have ever taken here at A&M. I took this as a GPA boost because I am wanting to get into grad school... having to drop. DO NOT LET THE COMMENTS FOOL YOU. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS, it might as well be called climate change MATH. HEAVYYYY math based, absolutely not.

10/10 recommend taking this class. It has been by far my favorite class at tamu this semester! Don't let the part about it being an asynchronous class fool you. He is very interactive and entertaining. His lectures are concise and his grading criteria is clear. Easy to make an A in the class if you put in the effort and watch the videos and read.
One of the best professors I have had at Texas A&M. The only thing that matches his knowledge of climate change is his care in educating his students on the matter.

This Professor has been one of the best professors i've had at A&M. His lectures are relevant and interesting and you can tell that he cares about what he teaches. I took this class online and all the lectures are posted weekly and then there are a couple other assignments. He had plenty of extra credit opportunities as well. Take this class!!

Professor Dessler is great; his class is split into a bunch of lecture videos each week all ending with a video of his dogs. As long as you read the book before exams, you really don't even have to watch the lectures though, if you don't want to.

Professor Dessler did the absolute most to make his videos fun and engaging. He explains everything very slowly and clearly, and encourages you to watch the videos again if you don't understand something. He actually wrote the textbook and so it is also super easy to read and understand the concepts. AMAZING PROF! (& he shows videos of his dogs!)
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Dessler is passionate about teaching others about climate change! his asynchronous lecture videos (b/c of COVID) were interesting and involved so much effort on his end! The tests are super duper specific so you have to read and watch his videos but theres not too much homework or many quizzes. This class will keep you up to date too!

GEOS 210 was my favorite class during the fall virtual school year. I DEFINITELY recommend taking his course. The tests are easy if you read the textbook, take notes, and watch his weekly videos reviewing materials. He was my most considerate professor during the pandemic with a reasonable course load that reflected his consideration.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He knows what he's talking about and explains everything so that it is interesting and easy to understand. There is quite a bit of math involved but he posts a lot of videos to help with that. He lays out everything he's putting on the exams and leaves you no surprises. He's one of the most empathetic professors I've had during the pandemic.

Dessler was fine. I took the class asynchronous with COVID. We had two group projects, and he didn't care that my group wasn't helping me. His lectures were entertaining, he gave a short clip of his dogs at the end of each. You can get an A in the class if you don't read the book but study hard for the tests.

This class is completely different for everyone. Dr. Dessler is extremely knowledgeable about Python and does a decent job teaching it. There are quizzes at the beginning of every class based off the assigned reading which is pretty short. There are a handful of homework assignments and a midterm and final. Overall it's fairly easy if you work.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This will not be an easy class unless you are a physics or chemistry person. Do not let the name deceive you. He spends more time on the mathematical aspect than anything. If you do not agree with him then you will have to just bite your tongue because he is one of those "know-it-all" types that shuts people down easily. No study guides either.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Do the readings and write down what he puts on the board. If he says "this will be on the exam" or "this would be a good test question" take special note of it! He's an amazing prof and I learned so much. This class has been a real eye-opener and really stuck with me. If you put in a bit of effort on your part then you'll do just fine!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Favorite prof. His lectures are interesting and easy to follow. Tests are fair. He wrote the textbook so that helps a lot. You have to read before coming to class because their are clicker quizzes at the beginning of each class but the readings are easy to follow and it was never too much to read. Highly recommend this class!

Dessler's a world-renowned climate scientist, which makes the course super interesting. Reading's necessary for the graded clicker questions in lecture but isn't hard(3 or 4 pages per lecture) and only helps in the long-run. He wrote the textbook, so the reading corresponds w/ lecture. Schrute bucks help a lot so speak up in class. My favorite prof
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: This class was one of my favorites classes. Yes you have to read but if youre even remotely interested in climate change its not bad at all. Dessler is funny and makes the lectures interesting and gives lots of examples to help you understand things. The clicker questions arent hard if you read the material. Overall very good class and relevant.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: Dessler is very educated and truly cares about what he is teaching and his students. He is very understanding, but if you're looking for an easy science credit this isn't it. You HAVE TO attend class and read all the chapters or else you're doomed. Also, since this class is so unique you won't find much help outside of him or your classmates.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Prof Dessler wrote the textbook himself, so he is very knowledgable, however the classes are extremely boring because of the way he has them formatted. You have to read the textbook before class to pass the clicker quiz, so then the class is an hour and 15 minutes of boring, old material. Would be more interesting if he would change this.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Most difficult yet most interesting class this semester. Prof. Dessler is passionate about what he teaches and is extremely knowledgeable. If you don't like to read, don't take this class. There is a clicker quiz at the beginning of every class over reading from the book. Extra credit in "Schrute bucks" that you get for asking/answering questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class can be difficult to some, although he is a great teacher it may be hard for the information to stick. Must pay attention to lectures and attend classes. Has extra credit in iclicker questions and in the form of "schrute bucks" when you engage in questions. Reading for textbook is required and lengthy.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Dessler is THE man. His class is structured such that the material builds on itself. He assigns reading that is often rather lengthy but they DO help students to understand the content. He gives short iClicker quizzes in the beginning of each class for a grade over the reading. Answer q's in class for extra credit. Moderately difficult exams.
